summary: Public projects created on 20 April 2026: 17 repos.
intro: A set of Claude Code plugins covered agent operations such as Android device management, backup planning, task queuing, and GitHub discovery. Other repositories held reference material and tools, among them indexes of Israeli online stores and open-source projects, data on geopolitical bodies for simulations, and a prompt builder for music.

projects.name: CAMEO Codebook
projects.description: Unofficial machine-readable (JSON/YAML) extraction of the CAMEO codebook used by GDELT/ACLED

projects.name: Claude ADB Ops Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin for Android Debug Bridge (ADB) operations — onboard a phone, save folder mappings, import media with one command, capture screenshots, and manage bloatware with a persistent,...

projects.name: Claude Backup Planner Plugin
projects.description: A Claude Code plugin that walks the user end-to-end through planning, documenting, and implementing a backup and data-protection strategy for the current project.

projects.name: Claude FX Pair Analyst Template
projects.description: Claude Code workspace for FX pair analysis — historical data, quant/econometrics, vol modelling, geopol context, Typst PDF reports. Part of New-Repo-From-Template-Plugin.

projects.name: Claude GitHub Explorer Plugin
projects.description: Semantic GitHub repo discovery for finding reusable open-source components.

projects.name: Claude Green Invoice Ops Plugin
projects.description: Green Invoice plugin providing Green Invoice/ Morning MCP and skill definitions to Claude Code

projects.name: Claude Israel Shopping Plugin
projects.description: Shopping plugin intended for Israeli residents covering domestic purchasing channels, common B2C overseas channels (Aliexperss, Amazon, iHerb), and with some data and search pattern mappings. WIP!

projects.name: Claude Pad
projects.description: A dedicated macropad for driving Claude Code — approve, stop, new session, navigate transcripts — with a host-driven status LED that lights up when Claude is waiting on you.

projects.name: Claude Task Queuer Plugin
projects.description: Simple Claude task actuator for adding task mgmt to repositories with support for agent sorting

projects.name: Claude Teach This Repo Plugin
projects.description: Use a real codebase in reverse for developer education.

projects.name: Claude Test Project Ideator Plugin
projects.description: Generate specifications for practice / "dummy" development projects tailored to what the user wants to learn, the stack they want to use, and how proficient they already are with each piece of it.

projects.name: Favorite Code Libraries
projects.description: A personal index of code libraries Daniel uses and likes — curated across languages and domains, with a short note on why each one earns its place.

projects.name: Israel Online Stores

projects.name: Israeli Open Source Projects
projects.description: Curated index of interesting open-source Israeli projects (data sources, civic tech, finance, careers, real estate, smart home, media). Sibling to Israeli-AI-Tools-And-Ecosystem.

projects.name: Stars Viewer
projects.description: Export of GitHub stars organized by type

projects.name: Suno Prompt Builder

projects.name: World Geopol Fora
